what: Among several pinned image plates on screen (default · per section), only the plate whose data-key matches the id of the section currently crossing the 80% line of the screen rises over 1s ease and the rest withdraw — in sections with no matching plate (News · Hours) it returns to the default plate. Below 768px only the default plate

options.watch: Section selectors to watch (comma-separated for several) — the section id pairs with the panel’s data-key
options.line: Screen line the section must pass (% from top), default 80
options.min: Below this width (px) it is not changed, default 768
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Stacked panels (children, section name via data-key) — first panel is the default

from.where: index.html .tn-fix (original .fix-picture__layer — an IntersectionObserver with rootMargin −80% 0 −20% 0 watches #office-hours · #obstetrics · #gynecology · #support · #access and adds .show to the layer of that name with -layer, otherwise the default layer shows, opacity 1s ease, desktop only)
